readings: For each film in the inventory, show its `film_id`, its number of copies (inventory records), and its share of all inventory copies (its copy count divided by the total number of copies across all films, unrounded). Sort from highest share to lowest and return the top 10 films, plus every other film whose copy count equals that of the 10th film, so no film tied at the cutoff is left out.
queries:
WITH film_copies AS (
  SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS copy_count
  FROM inventory
  GROUP BY film_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    film_id,
    copy_count,
    SUM(copy_count) OVER () AS total_copies,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY copy_count DESC) AS copy_rank
  FROM film_copies
)
SELECT
  film_id,
  copy_count,
  CAST(copy_count AS REAL) / total_copies AS share
FROM ranked
WHERE copy_rank <= 10
ORDER BY share DESC, film_id
